findings.title: worker:lost rose from 2 to 10, so the 'no worker:lost' growth check fails (12 of 15)
findings.where: locomotion / homing (ants/behaviours/outdoor phaseTravel.ts RETURN_LOST_S); probe test-output/colony-life/round-8/sweep-review/probe-lost-pp1.txt, probe-lost-we1b.txt
findings.detail: The lost workers are caught in traps, not out on long trips. In pp #1 all 6 lost foragers die at the same point (~920, -11.3, 3593 BU), 82.5 BU from the open entrance. They are in forage.return and shuffle within 3 BU for 1000-1400 s until RETURN_LOST_S. The point is the bottom of a shallow terrain bowl (height -11.33 BU, nav cells not blocked). In we #1, 2 of the 3 lost foragers die 0.1-0.4 BU from their own open entrance (plugVoxelCount 4, nav still 'moving') after 1290 s. No stuck report fires for any of them. Restoring the cached hand-over reproduces each run's deaths exactly. Round 8 did not change locomotion, but R30 keeps workers alive long enough to die this way.

findings.where: colony/founding hand-over reopen + nest locomotion legs; probe test-output/colony-life/round-8/sweep-review/probe-idle-sg3.txt
findings.detail: The entrance reads 'open' but 29-33 plug voxels are still left in it. The scout's depart nav fails with 'leg' every game hour, and foragers wait because they know no source. By 5.6 gd all 10 workers report nav failed:leg, inside the nest too (queen-care, haul, store, idle). This is the failure the known red founding/reopen.test pins (plug soil left in the throat), now seen in a sweep run, plus a nest-wide leg failure that the red test does not cover.

findings.title: F1 readers bypass the GDD 03 §11.2 spill rebuild throttle
findings.detail: Over 300 ticks, with a carve every 10 ticks in a wet nest and one reader call per tick: 30 buildSpill calls against 6 for the throttled flood model (which allows 7), 2.5-3.1 ms each on the small test nest. In the sweep, flee-water rose from 0.014 to 0.055 ms/tick (median) and the total from 4.05 to 4.34 ms/tick (timings are noisy under load). Determinism is fine.

findings.title: Round numbers not reproduced on fresh foundings
findings.detail: Trip success 45.9 % here against 50.4 % in the r30hb1 arm. Viable 9 against 10 in the r30r29c arm. Median P 0.269 against 0.287. The R19 trip-success check is still failed.

findings.title: R30 item not done: DIAG_MORTALITY_REF_LIFESPAN_GD still 26
findings.detail: Direction 15 says this constant should be re-derived by measurement. The ledger's 09:18 entry derives a realised lifespan of 36-39 gd under R30 and defers the change. As a result diag-mortality judges deaths against a reference turnover that is 1.4-1.5 x the natural one (diagnostics only).

findings.title: workedExample red is noise in a 10-seed test, not an R29c rule change; FD1 overclaimed
findings.detail: With the care factor forced to 1 (scratch copy) the test passes. Larval C per larva is identical (0.909 in both runs). Only the larvae count moves, 4.55 -> 4.67, because the factor changes the RNG trajectory of the laying draws. The base already sits at 3.7 % of the 5 % bound. Separately, the round says FD1 fixed the browser founding, but direction 20.1 records that founding still failing after FD1.
